name: units_of_production_depletion_reestimate_and_development_cost
question_template: A mine is bought at the start of Year 1 for {COST} USD; land residual value {RESID} USD is recoverable after extraction. Initial ore estimate: {N0} units. Rate per unit = carrying amount minus residual value, divided by estimated remaining units when set; yearly depletion = units extracted times the rate in force. Extraction is {E12} units in each of Years 1 and 2. At the start of Year 3 (before extraction) remaining ore is re-estimated at {NREM} units, replacing the earlier one; a new rate is set prospectively from the carrying amount then, with no restatement of prior years. Year 3 extraction is {E3} units. After Year 3 depletion, a one-time development cost of {DEV} USD is capitalized at end of Year 3 (no residual, not recurring). At the start of Year 4 the rate is reset from the carrying amount then and remaining units of {NREM} minus Year 3 extraction. Year 4 extraction is {E4} units; if it exceeds remaining estimated units, depletion is charged only on the remaining units. Carrying amount = total capitalized cost minus accumulated depletion since acquisition. Find the Year 3 rate per unit, Year 3 depletion, end-of-Year-4 accumulated depletion and carrying amount, and Year 4 depletion.

slots.description: Depletion rate per unit set at start of Year 3 after reserve re-estimate
Accumulated depletion at end of Year 4 covering all four years
Carrying amount at end of Year 4 after development cost and depletion

program:
def solve():
    C = Q(P["COST"])
    R = Q(P["RESID"])
    N0 = Q(P["N0"])
    E12 = Q(P["E12"])
    NREM = Q(P["NREM"])
    E3 = Q(P["E3"])
    D = Q(P["DEV"])
    E4 = Q(P["E4"])
    if 2 * E12 >= N0:
        raise ValueError("Years 1-2 extraction exhausts original reserve estimate")
    if E3 >= NREM:
        raise ValueError("Year 3 extraction exhausts revised reserve estimate")
    rate0 = (C - R) / N0
    dep12 = rate0 * 2 * E12
    cv2 = C - dep12
    rate3 = (cv2 - R) / NREM
    dep3 = rate3 * E3
    cv3 = cv2 - dep3 + D
    rem4 = NREM - E3
    rate4 = (cv3 - R) / rem4
    units4 = E4 if E4 < rem4 else rem4
    dep4 = rate4 * units4
    acc4 = dep12 + dep3 + dep4
    cv4 = C + D - acc4
    return {
        "final": dep4,
        "year3_rate_per_unit": rate3,
        "year3_depletion": dep3,
        "accumulated_depletion_end_year4": acc4,
        "carrying_amount_end_year4": cv4,
    }
